quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines mean?

options.text: You can pass from the left.
You can pass from the right.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic moves in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.question: What should you do if you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane?

options.text: The pedestrian must yield to you.
You must yield to the pedestrian.
Honk your horn to alert them.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield to the pedestrian.
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the person is blind or partially blind. You must yield the right-of-way to them.

questions.question: How should you enter a gap in highway traffic?

options.text: Watch only the vehicles behind the gap.
Look behind you, then watch the vehicle ahead.
Speed up and let other vehicles move out of your way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look behind you, then watch the vehicle ahead.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check the side and behind your vehicle for traffic. Make sure the lane you want to enter is clear.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You can turn in that direction after slowing down and checking traffic.
You cannot turn in that direction until the light is green.
You can turn in that direction after you stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn in that direction until the light is green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. Do not turn. Wait for a green light or green arrow before turning in that direction.

questions.question: When should your wheels NOT point straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to turn left at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
When parked on a level roadway with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
questions.explanation: When parked on a hill, angle your wheels away from traffic. This stops your vehicle from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail. When waiting to turn left, keep wheels straight so a rear impact doesn't push you into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Speed up to avoid an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use low beam lights. If visibility is too poor, pull off the road and wait for the fog to clear.

questions.question: What should you do when you reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as vehicles from your right and left?

options.text: Yield to the vehicle on your left.
Yield to the vehicle on your right.
Wait until all vehicles have left the intersection before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to the vehicle on your right.
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection with multiple vehicles arriving at the same time, the vehicle on your right has the right-of-way. Proceed in the order vehicles arrived.

questions.question: What lights should you use in rain or fog?

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in rain or fog. They help other drivers see you, even if they don't help you see much better.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in school zones?

options.text: 15 mph.
20 mph.
25 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: 20 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in school zones is 20 mph. Watch for children near schools, playgrounds, and in neighborhoods. Drive slowly and carefully where children are present.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ends ahead.
You must turn right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead. You must choose to turn right or left.

questions.question: When is it safe to pass another vehicle?

options.text: In an intersection if there are no oncoming vehicles.
Only where signs and pavement markings allow passing.
On a curve if there are no oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only where signs and pavement markings allow passing.
questions.explanation: Never pass in intersections, parking lots, or alleys. Do not pass on curves or hills where you cannot see oncoming traffic. Only pass where signs and pavement markings permit it, and only if you have enough space to do so safely.

questions.question: When turning left, who must you yield to?

options.text: Cars that are passing you.
Oncoming cars.
No one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Oncoming cars.
questions.explanation: You must yield to oncoming vehicles when turning left. Wait until oncoming traffic passes before making your turn.

questions.question: If you are angry after an argument, what should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you don't think about it.
Wait a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to calm down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your driving ability. If you are angry, upset, or worried, take time to calm down before driving. You need to focus on the road, not your problems.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mean you are near a school zone. Stay alert and be ready to stop if you see children.

questions.question: What is the amount of alcohol in your blood called?

options.text: Implied consent (IC).
Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
Rate of alcohol consumption (RAC).

questions.correctAnswerText: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures the percentage of alcohol in your blood. A higher BAC means you are more impaired.

questions.question: Which road is most likely to be slippery in cold weather after snow or rain?

options.text: A hilly, open road.
A residential road.
A road in a shaded area.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road in a shaded area.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas on roads freeze first and thaw last. These spots are more likely to be icy in cold, wet weather.

questions.question: What does this red and white sign mean?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Let other traffic pass before you go.
Keep going at the same speed and watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let all vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turns.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: Backing your vehicle is:

options.text: Always dangerous.
Dangerous if you have a helper.
Only dangerous in large vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always dangerous.
questions.explanation: Backing up is always dangerous because you cannot see well behind your vehicle. Always use extra caution when backing up.

questions.question: If your vehicle begins to skid, you should:

options.text: Release the gas pedal.
Brake as hard as possible.
Turn off the ignition.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, release the gas or brake pedal to regain control. Steer in the direction of the skid.

questions.question: When you see this stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you are going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: You are driving on a city street and see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Drive to the right edge of the road and slow down.
Drive to the right edge of the road and stop.
Stay in your lane, slow down, and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right edge of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any emergency vehicle using its siren and lights. Drive to the right edge and stop until it passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through first, then stop.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle:

options.text: Pass as slowly as possible.
Drive at the same speed as the vehicle you are passing.
Pass as safely and quickly as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass as safely and quickly as possible.
questions.explanation: Pass quickly to stay visible. Return to your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When passing another car, you have enough space to return to the driving lane:

options.text: If the other driver signals for you to re-enter the lane.
If you look over your shoulder and see the passed car behind you.
If you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before returning to your lane, ensure there is a safe gap between your vehicle and the passed vehicle. When you see both headlights in your rearview mirror, it is safe to return to the driving lane.

questions.question: For a person 21 years of age or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.05 percent or higher.
0.08 percent or higher.
0.02 percent or higher.

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent or higher.
questions.explanation: For drivers age 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; curving road ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.
No passing zone.
Work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.
